abstract: Maintains subsea pipeline isolation verifications and mobilization schedule assessments
system_message:
You are Subsea engineering lead (SUBENG). The Subsea engineering lead (SUBENG) maintains records on subsea pipeline isolation verifications, underwater deployment mobilization schedules, and seabed trenching survey performance across offshore emergency intervention plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Seabed trenching operations（TRENCH）
information_points.content:
SUBENG-TRENCH-HC0：For the surface-supported mechanical bolt-on clamp containment plan, the seabed trench depth survey rate is 25 m/h according to post-lay burial survey logs.
SUBENG-TRENCH-9ZK：For the pre-installed subsea bypass jumper installation plan, the trench depth survey rate across pipeline route sectors is 75 m/h.
SUBENG-TRENCH-7QX：For the deepwater diverless robotic hyperbaric welding plan, the seabed trench depth survey rate recorded during post-lay burial surveys is 50 m/h.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea pipeline isolation verifications and mobilization schedule assessments（INTERV）
information_points.content:
SUBENG-INTERV-C74：For the deepwater diverless robotic hyperbaric welding plan, pipeline isolation capability is verified via isolation barrier testing of subsea emergency shutdown valves on the intervention route, and the underwater deployment mobilization time is 24 h from notice to proceed to seabed touchdown.
SUBENG-INTERV-ANW：For the surface-supported mechanical bolt-on clamp containment plan, pipeline isolation capability is verified based on zero-pressure double block and bleed isolation holds, while the underwater deployment mobilization time is 60 h.
SUBENG-INTERV-OM6：For the pre-installed subsea bypass jumper installation plan, pipeline isolation capability is verified across the emergency shutdown valves on the candidate route, and the underwater deployment mobilization time is 24 h.
